edition.title: 101 Essays That Will Change The Way You Think

description.value: *Bringing together Brianna Wiest's most influential writing on self-awareness, emotional intelligence, and personal transformation. Through short, thought-provoking pieces, Wiest explores how habits, beliefs, and unconscious patterns shape the way we experience our lives. The essay challenge readers to question assumptions, break unhelpful cycles, and adopt more intentional ways of thinking. Blending psychology, and modern self-development, the book encourages deeper reflection on identity, relationships, creativity, and resilience. Both practical and reflective, it serves as a guide for anyone seeking clarity, growth, and a more conscious approach to everyday life.*

edition.subtitle: "How to Rethink Your Life, One idea at a Time"
